label: Terse and busy
description: Answers in as few words as possible, often in fragments, typed quickly between other things. Gives the requested facts but no extra colour, and does not ask follow-up questions unless something is unclear.
traits: very short replies, often one line
fragments and abbreviations such as 'k' for kilometres
mildly impatient when asked several questions at once
examples: Same as before, a few runs a week.
Only the days I said. Weekend for the long one.
Don't know. Just pick something sensible.
